main.description: A single espresso shot pulled on Patrick's machine, sourced from visualizer.coffee via the pd-coffee service. One record per shot; the record key is the visualizer.coffee shot UUID, so re-writing the same shot overwrites rather than duplicates.

shotId.description: visualizer.coffee shot UUID. Always equals the record key.

startTime.description: When the shot was pulled (ISO 8601 UTC).

profileTitle.description: Machine profile used for the shot.

coffeeBag.description: Coffee bag name when the service resolved one.

decaf.description: True when the shot was pulled with decaf beans.

createdAt.description: When this record was written (not when the shot was pulled).
